item: Row 367 batch 4: Settings Ollama installer, models box, default model and language detection follow a language switch
key_paths: src/static/app-settings.js; src/static/locales/*.json; configs/i18n_frozen_renderers.txt; tests/settings_ai_install_live_node_test.js; tests/test_settings_ai_install_live.py; tests/test_repo_invariants.py; tests/test_destructive_surfaces.py
summary: Eight frozen renderers in app-settings.js (loadOllamaInstall, prepareOllamaInstall, runOllamaInstall, loadLlmModels, _paintDefaultModel, _installDefaultModel, pollLangDetect, loadLangDetectCount) now draw through ooLive/ooLiveHtml, so a language switch redraws them with no request; app-settings.js leaves configs/i18n_frozen_renderers.txt entirely. Panels repainted from inside (#llm-install-box, #llm-models-box) are drawn bare and their parts held one by one. _paintDefaultModel is split into its reads and _defaultModelHtml; a download started from its button is drawn as Starting by that render (_dmStarting). The installer log is one list with one render, and a non-zero exit uses the new key 'Installer exited with code {code}.' x12 (S1) instead of a welded number. The count's hover on #langdetect-status is the new labelled count 'Articles still in an unknown language after the offline detector: {n}.' x12 (W1, replacing the 'article(s)' weld), rides on a span the render draws, and the poll's detail is escaped once (it showed & as &). pullModel's queued line is 'Queued: {tag}' through the existing label frame, the tag in translate=no (W2, no new key). Dead code removed: runLangDetect and _paintLangDetectButton (the button left the page 2026-08-04), pinned ABSENT with #langdetect-btn in test_repo_invariants; the destructive-surfaces exemption for runLangDetect goes with it; three keys no longer used leave the locales.
